### Author checklist

- [ ] Linked to one issue with a closing keyword (`Closes #…`, `Fixes #…`, or `Resolves #…`)
- [ ] PR title uses Conventional Commit style (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`) so the squashed commit is clear
- [ ] Related tests updated and passing
- [ ] `just check` passes and CI is green
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings included for UI changes
- [ ] Database or API schema changes are documented
- [ ] I understand and can explain every change in this PR, including AI-written code
